MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.title: The Mad Scientist
MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.description:
A tinkerer who scavenges the Spire's scrap heaps.
Turns junk, fumes and questionable chemistry into power.

MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.goldMonologue: [sine]Ooh, shiny. That will fetch a few reagents.[/sine]
MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.cardsModifier: Mad Scientist cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
